question: Pointing to the photograph of a man, Muskan said, “He is the only grandson of my father’s grandfather”. How is Muskan related to the man in the photograph?
solution:

Given: Pointing to the photograph of a man, Muskan said, “He is the only grandson of my father’s grandfather”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed42d7674036b89305d8132f0deec4c162b694da233cb10456fbafd9ffd9218b.png] 

Muskan's gender is not given. So, Muskan is either the Son or Daughter of the man in the photograph.

In the given options, the son is not mentioned,

Therefore, Muskan is the **Daughter** of the man in the photograph

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**
